label: Pointless
explanation: Can't penetrate in any reasonable amount of hits

label: It's possible, but...
explanation: Typically doesn't penetrate at all for a large number of hits, or starts with a very low chance and barely increases

label: Magdump only
explanation: Has a very low or no penetration chance initially and very slowly gains chance

label: Slightly effective
explanation: Has a low penetration chance initially and slowly gains chance, or quickly damages armor until it penetrates

label: Effective
explanation: Starts with a low-medium penetration chance but quickly increases

label: Very effective
explanation: Penetrates a large percent of the time initially, often quickly going to >90%
